route: real player click-through (title -> Crucible door -> hull/seed -> Hold the line)
webglRenderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Graphics (0x00007D45) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

hullWait.evidence: three.js onAfterRender on the authored LOD parts, counted only for the on-screen pass through the shipping camera, attributed to whichever ship the mesh is on at read time, + lit pixels in a box at the projected hull
hullWait.knownLimits: no occlusion test; the lit-pixel box does not separate hull from background

captureMethod: cdp screencast, jpeg q92 (passive; the compositor hands over frames it already drew)
tickBasis: run-relative (state.tick minus the tick at launch)

visibleJitter.note: 13 contact window(s) of 0.5s at >= 7.2 fps; a reversal inside a window is a wobble a viewer sees

momentFilter: physics:impact kept only when it involves the player or exchanges >= 40 momentum; moments within 0.5s merged
